video_title: “We Battled, But Were A Bit Too Handsy.” | Chris Finch Postgame Sound | 10.31.26

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on Timberwolves' fourth-quarter decision-making and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: We had chances, we had to be smarter. Didn't like our decision-making and our careless turnovers in the fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: We had chances, we had to be smarter. Didn't like our decision-making and our careless turnovers in the fourth quarter, particularly.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch was not happy with the Timberwolves late game execution tonight saying he did not like our decision making and our careless turnovers in the fourth quarter particularly

structured.context: Chris Finch discusses the team's poor execution and turnovers during the fourth quarter of the game.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch addresses Karl-Anthony Towns' foul trouble and officiating
quotes.excerpt: To be fair, they're fouling him all over the floor. They got their hands on him.
quotes.quote: To be fair, they're fouling him all over the floor. They got their hands on him, they're bumping him, they're holding him, they're riding him off his line. And at the other end of the floor, he's being whistled for a bunch of touch fouls. The way that they allow people to just put their hands on him over the full court, I thought we got rid of that stuff in the 80s, but apparently not.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch voiced frustration with the officiating regarding Karl Anthony Towns saying he thought we got rid of that stuff in the 80s but apparently not

structured.context: Chris Finch criticizes the officiating regarding the physical treatment of Karl-Anthony Towns throughout the game.
